calibration.note: alpha = median over development conditions (DCF-13B fixture offsets +300000) of enumeration seconds-per-work over elimination seconds-per-work; frozen in calibration13d.json before the fresh run

part_c.prior: w ~ U[0,1] shared by all ambiguous triple sensors of an episode

gates.A1: hybrid_cost decisions identical to full enumeration, zero skips, max posterior delta < 1e-10, in all 36 conditions
gates.A2: hybrid_cost median time <= min(component_full, ve_full) in >= 27/36 conditions
gates.A3: ve_symbolic work equals executed eliminate() work in every episode
gates.B1: every non-declined fg.variable_elimination posterior equals the Numba full-enumeration posterior within 1e-9
gates.C1: bma_exact equals 16-point Gauss-Legendre BMA over independent brute-force masses within 1e-9; oracle_w equals brute force within 1e-9 (audited episodes)
gates.C2: credal actions: zero audited actions below confidence 0.8 on a 101-point w grid, and zero actions with negative expected utility under the oracle posterior in any episode
gates.C3: bma_exact mean expected utility >= plugin_half mean expected utility over the 9 conditions, and credal_shared_d6 coverage > pointwise_robust coverage in >= 8/9 conditions

protocol.no_tuning: fresh seeds are run once after calibration13d.json is committed; no arm, threshold or gate is changed after opening them
